116: How many credits does a cake design cost?
117: Each cake design costs {credits} credits and is produced in studio-quality 4K Ultra HD. New accounts get {welcome} credits as a welcome gift.
118: How much do bigger packs save?
119: The bigger the pack, the lower the price per credit. On the My Credits screen you can see how much each pack saves compared with the smallest pack, and its price per design.
120: What happens to my credits if an image can't be created?
121: If an image can't be produced because of a technical error, the credits are returned to your balance automatically. You don't need to do anything.
123: Tap "Restore Purchases" at the bottom of the My Credits screen. If the problem continues, write to us through "Report a Problem".
124: How do I request a refund?
125: All payments are processed by Apple or Google, so refunds are requested through that store's refund process. For failed designs, just write to us.
127: What does the inspiration photo do?
128: When you upload a photo such as an invitation, wedding dress fabric or party theme, the AI adapts its colours and patterns to your cake. The photo is completely optional.
129: How do I change a finished design?
130: On the result screen, tap "Edit" and describe the details you want to change. Each new image uses {credits} credits.
132: Every design you create is saved automatically to the Collection tab. You can also save the photo to your gallery with "Download Image".
135: When you add a special day, you choose when to be reminded (same day, 1 day, 3 days, 1 week, 2 weeks or 1 month before); the notification arrives at 10:00 AM that day.
136: I'm not getting notifications. What should I do?
137: Make sure the app is allowed to send notifications in your device settings.
138: How do I change the app language?
139: The app language is set automatically from your device’s region. To change it, go to your device’s Settings > General > Language & Region.
140: How do I delete my account?
141: Tap "Delete Account" at the bottom of the Profile tab and confirm.
